reviewItem.question: Does "The `cilium_api_limiter_processed_requests_total` has now label `return_code` to specify the http code of the request" mean a change to config-key:cilium|path=cilium_api_limiter_processed_requests_total (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: The cilium_api_limiter_processed_requests_total metric gains a new label return_code carrying the HTTP code of the request.
